entries.reason: Extend the extracted CLI with a fail-closed local studio review command that verifies an explicitly approved handoff against an immutable Brand Kit release without granting it asset or canonical-source write authority.

Add the fail-closed local studio review boundary: it records named approval, binds the handoff to an immutable release, reconciles deterministic profiles, preserves review lifecycle history, and rejects canonical or generated-state mutation.

Continue the intentional post-extraction evolution from #10, #11, #12, and #14 by exporting governed visual-motion validation and the framework-neutral reference-renderer adapter, then register the local studio review command from #15 while preserving the original Empathy extraction digest, standalone CLI behavior, and existing profile inventory.
